sections.content: To say what means of transport you're using, add -val or -vel (vowel harmony decides which) to the noun. If the noun ends in a consonant, that consonant doubles and replaces the v of the suffix: busz + val becomes busszal, not 'buszval'.
The v-to-consonant swap is the tricky part: busz -> busszal (v becomes sz), vonat -> vonattal (v becomes t). Vowel-final words are simpler and just add -val/-vel directly, e.g. taxi -> taxival.
